name: DirectVoxGO
definition: A neural radiance field implementation using voxel grids for density and color features, supporting both standard dense grids and FourierGrid variants, with occupancy caching and near-camera voxel masking.
summary: DirectVoxGO is a differentiable volume rendering method that replaces NeRF's neural network with a dense 3D voxel grid, enabling super-fast training convergence and reduced memory overhead.
